objectives.summary: The project aims to launch the Tipcast app in the iTunes App Store by February 2014, allowing users to share and follow developing stories. The app includes features such as chapter updates, photo uploads, voice narration, and a music library, targeting personal, business, and local news sharing.
key_points: The team aims to launch Tipcast in the iTunes App Store by February 2014.
Tipcast allows users to create updates to a story in chapters that are 15 seconds long.
Users can upload photos, add text overlays, and zoom and pan through images in Tipcast.
The app includes a royalty-free music library for users to add soundtracks.
Users can add voice narration by recording with their smartphone microphone.
Tipcast is designed to share personal, business, or local news stories.
